basic_details.job_title: CSIR CGCRI Project Associate - I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (CSIR-CGCRI), Kolkata, will hold a walk-in interview on 30 October 2026 from 2.30 p.m. for one Project Associate - I (PAT - I) under the CSIR-sponsored project "CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative" (HCP002502), at a stipend of Rs. 25,000/- + HRA. The tenure is initially up to 31.03.2027. The post needs a B.E./B.Tech in Ceramic / Materials Science or an M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics, with at least 55% marks. Candidates must email the filled application form to [email protected] by 29 October 2026.

important_dates.interview_date: 30/10/2026 from 2.30 p.m. (report at least one hour earlier)

qualification.details: B.E./B.Tech in Ceramic / Materials Science with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA / DGPA Or , M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA / DGPA | Candidates with results awaited will not be eligible. Candidates must calculate the percentage from CGPA/DGPA as per the calculation rule of their University/Institute and attach a self-attested soft copy of that rule.

how_to_apply: Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be received by 29 October 2026. No application will be entertained after that date. The notice asks for the following:
Fill in the Application Form in the prescribed format furnished with the notice. It must be TYPED, not hand-written.
Attach soft copies of self-attested copies of each supporting document, certificate and reprint.
If your marks are in CGPA/DGPA, attach a self-attested soft copy of your University/Institute's rule for converting them into a percentage.
If you are presently engaged in any project at CSIR-CGCRI or any other Organization/Lab/Institute, attach a copy of the NOC from your existing Project Leader.
Send the soft copy of the application to [email protected] by 29 October 2026.

A separate application is required if you apply for more than one position or advertisement number. Incomplete applications, or applications not in the prescribed format and without supporting documents, will be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: CSIR-CGCRI reserves the right not to fill up the position, if so desired by the Competent Authority. The number of positions may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the Institute. The decision of the Institute shall be final in this regard. Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview is open to bonafide Indian citizens. B.E./B.Tech in Ceramic / Materials Science with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA / DGPA Or , M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA / DGPA Candidates with results awaited will not be eligible. Candidates must calculate the percentage from CGPA/DGPA as per the calculation rule of their University/Institute and attach a self-attested soft copy of that rule. Preference will be given to those candidates having research experience in nano-materials synthesis and characterizations. The age limit is 35 years as on the date of interview (30 October 2026). content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I (PAT - I)
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be received by 29 October 2026. No application will be entertained after that date. The notice asks for the following: Fill in the Application Form in the prescribed format furnished with the notice. It must be TYPED, not hand-written. Attach soft copies of self-attested copies of each supporting document, certificate and reprint. If your marks are in CGPA/DGPA, attach a self-attested soft copy of your University/Institute's rule for converting them into a percentage. If you are presently engaged in any project at CSIR-CGCRI or any other Organization/Lab/Institute, attach a copy of the NOC from your existing Project Leader. Send the soft copy of the application to [email protected] by 29 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at the Institute (CSIR-CGCRI, 196, Raja S. C. Mullick Road, Kolkata-32) on 30 October 2026 from 2.30 p.m. Report at least one hour before the scheduled time of interview for verification of documents. No candidate will be allowed to enter the Institute after the reporting time. Bring the original marksheets, certificates and age/caste proof for verification. Carry self-attested copies of all documents and of your project thesis (if any).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-CGCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Associate - I (PAT – I) under Advt. No. 54/2627/4MD/HCP002502/PKS.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The application must reach [email protected] by 29 October 2026. The walk-in interview is on 30 October 2026 from 2.30 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech in Ceramic / Materials Science, or an M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics, with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA / DGPA. Research experience in nano-materials synthesis and characterizations is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on the date of interview. SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female candidates get up to 5 years' relaxation, and OBCs (Non-Creamy layer) get 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 25,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the stipend as Rs. 25,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CSIR-CGCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email a typed application form in the prescribed format, with self-attested soft copies of all supporting documents, to [email protected] by 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview at CSIR-CGCRI on 30 October 2026 from 2.30 p.m. Candidates must report at least one hour early with their original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a project post under "CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative", initially up to 31.03.2027. It can be extended up to 31.03.2030, based on the availability of funds.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates whose results are awaited apply?
faq.answer: No. Candidates with results awaited will not be eligible for the Project Associate - I post.
